name: Ian Rush
clue1_en: I'm one of ten children from North Wales. My first club, a small English side, sold me for a record fee for a teenager.
clue1_ar: أنا واحد من عشرة إخوة من شمال ويلز. وباعني ناديي الأول، وهو فريق إنجليزي صغير، بمبلغ قياسي للاعب مراهق.
clue2_en: I rarely took penalties, but I scored one in the shootout as we won the 1984 European Cup in Rome. Later, I spent one season in Italy.
clue2_ar: نادراً ما سدّدت ركلات الجزاء، لكنني سجّلت ركلتي في الترجيح حين فزنا بكأس أوروبا 1984 في روما. ولاحقاً قضيت موسماً واحداً في إيطاليا.
clue3_en: I'm Liverpool's all-time top scorer. I scored twice against Everton in two different FA Cup finals.
clue3_ar: أنا الهداف التاريخي لليفربول، وسجّلت هدفين في مرمى إيفرتون في نهائيين مختلفين لكأس إنجلترا.
notes: sources: raised in Flint with four sisters and five brothers (ninth of ten) — https://www.lfchistory.net/Players/Player/Profile/404 ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ian_Rush ; Chester record teenage fee — old set + Wikipedia; scored Liverpool's fourth kick in 1984 shootout v Roma, not a regular taker (3 of 346 Liverpool goals from the spot) — Wikipedia + lfchistory + https://legacy.liverpoolfc.com/news/first-team/126843-rome-penalty-was-my-pinnacle ; two goals v Everton in 1986 and 1989 FA Cup finals — Wikipedia + lfchistory; Juventus 1987–88 — facts.jsonl; 346 goals club record — lfchistory.

name: David Seaman
clue1_en: Leeds released me as a teenager, and I joined Peterborough for about €4,500.
clue1_ar: استغنى عني ليدز وأنا مراهق، فانضممت إلى بيتربره مقابل نحو 4500 يورو.
clue2_en: I was famously lobbed from 40 yards in the last minute of the 1995 Cup Winners' Cup final.
clue2_ar: تلقيت هدفاً ساقطاً شهيراً من مسافة 40 ياردة في الدقيقة الأخيرة من نهائي كأس الكؤوس الأوروبية 1995.
clue3_en: I won three league titles with Arsenal. After I retired, I had my famous ponytail cut off on live TV for a cancer charity.
clue3_ar: فزت بثلاثة ألقاب للدوري مع أرسنال. وبعد اعتزالي قصصت ذيل الحصان الشهير في شعري على الهواء مباشرة لصالح جمعية خيرية لمكافحة السرطان.
notes: sources: ponytail cut off live on ITV's This Morning, Nov 2005, for the Bobby Moore Fund (bowel cancer research) — https://whufc.com/news/articles/2005/november/08-november/david-seaman-goes-chop ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Seaman ; retired Jan 2004 — Wikipedia; three titles with Arsenal — old set. Clues 1 and 2 unchanged. Strictly Ice Dancing win left out (Wikipedia only).

name: Gianfranco Zola
clue1_en: I grew up in a Sardinian village and played in the lower divisions until I was 23.
clue1_ar: نشأت في قرية بسردينيا، ولعبت في الدرجات الدنيا حتى سن الثالثة والعشرين.
clue2_en: At Napoli, I watched the world's best player in training to learn how to curl a free kick. We won the league in 1990.
clue2_ar: في نابولي كنت أراقب أفضل لاعب في العالم خلال التدريب لأتعلّم منه تسديد الركلات الحرة المقوّسة، وفزنا بالدوري عام 1990.
clue3_en: I starred for Chelsea from 1996 to 2003. In my last game, for my home island's club, I scored twice against Juventus.
clue3_ar: تألقت مع تشيلسي من 1996 إلى 2003. وفي آخر مباراة لي، مع نادي جزيرتي، سجّلت هدفين في مرمى يوفنتوس.
notes: sources: 'I used to spy on him every time he trained and learned how to curl a free-kick' (Zola on Maradona); hours after training on set pieces — https://thesefootballtimes.co/2017/09/28/gianfranco-zola-and-diego-maradona-at-napoli-the-student-and-the-mentor/ ; 'I learned everything from Diego', practised free kicks with him — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gianfranco_Zola ; 1990 Scudetto — old set; last game, end of 2004–05, scored twice for Cagliari in 4–2 loss to Juventus — https://www.planetfootball.com/nostalgia/the-last-goodbye-when-a-37-year-old-gianfranco-zola-brought-glory-to-sardinia ; https://www.juventus.com/it/news/articoli/juve-cagliari-5-nomi-5-momenti ; Wikipedia; Chelsea 1996–2003 — facts.jsonl. Clue 1 unchanged.

name: Oliver Bierhoff
clue1_en: I started at Uerdingen and played in Austria and at Ascoli before breaking through in Udine.
clue1_ar: بدأت في أوردينغن، ولعبت في النمسا وفي أسكولي قبل أن أبرز في أوديني.
clue2_en: In the Euro 96 final, I came off the bench and scored both our goals. The second was the first golden goal in a major final.
clue2_ar: في نهائي يورو 96 دخلت بديلاً وسجّلت هدفَي فريقنا، وكان الثاني أول هدف ذهبي في نهائي بطولة كبرى.
clue3_en: I was Serie A's top scorer with Udinese, then won the title at AC Milan. In my last game, I scored a hat-trick against Juventus.
clue3_ar: كنت هداف الدوري الإيطالي مع أودينيزي، ثم فزت باللقب مع ميلان. وفي آخر مباراة لي سجّلت ثلاثية في مرمى يوفنتوس.
notes: sources: came on as sub and scored the equaliser and golden goal in Euro 96 final — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oliver_Bierhoff + old set; Serie A top scorer 1997–98 (27) and 1998–99 Milan title — Wikipedia + old set; last game, hat-trick for Chievo in 3–4 loss at Juventus, end of 2002–03 — Wikipedia ; https://vnexpress.net/chievo-danh-mat-co-hoi-du-cup-uefa-915912.html ; https://espndeportes.espn.com/futbolitaliano/noticias/bierhoffadios210503.html (search snippet). Clue 1 unchanged. Business degree by correspondence left out (only listicle sources).

name: Marc Overmars
clue1_en: I grew up on a farm in Gelderland and started at Go Ahead Eagles. At 22, a knee injury ruled me out of Euro 96.
clue1_ar: نشأت في مزرعة بمقاطعة خيلدرلاند وبدأت مع غو أهيد إيغلز. وفي الثانية والعشرين أبعدتني إصابة في الركبة عن يورو 96.
clue2_en: In March 1998, I scored the only goal at Old Trafford. Two months later, I opened the scoring in the FA Cup final as we won the double.
clue2_ar: في مارس 1998 سجّلت هدف المباراة الوحيد على ملعب أولد ترافورد. وبعد شهرين افتتحت التسجيل في نهائي كأس إنجلترا وفزنا بالثنائية.
clue3_en: I left Arsenal for Barcelona in 2000 for about €29m.
clue3_ar: انتقلت من أرسنال إلى برشلونة عام 2000 مقابل نحو 29 مليون يورو.
notes: sources: cruciate knee injury Dec 1995 ruled him out of Euro 96 — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marc_Overmars ; https://www.arsenal.com/node/7572 ; only goal in 1–0 win at Old Trafford, March 1998 — Wikipedia ; https://blog.woolwicharsenal.co.uk/?p=24287 (search snippet; arsenal.com profile also cited by search); opened scoring in 1998 FA Cup final v Newcastle, double — old set + Wikipedia; farm in Emst, Go Ahead Eagles, Barcelona €29.3m 2000 — old set + facts.jsonl. Grandfather potato-harvest story left out (Wikipedia + a podcast blurb only).

name: Jay-Jay Okocha
clue1_en: I went to Germany to visit a friend, asked to join in at his club's training, and stayed to play for them.
clue1_ar: ذهبت إلى ألمانيا لزيارة صديق، وطلبت المشاركة في تدريب ناديه، فبقيت ولعبت معه.
clue2_en: In 1993, my solo goal past the Karlsruhe goalkeeper was voted Germany's goal of the year. In 1996, I won Olympic gold.
clue2_ar: عام 1993 اختير هدفي الفردي في مرمى حارس كارلسروه أفضل هدف في ألمانيا لذلك العام. وفي 1996 فزت بالذهبية الأولمبية.
clue3_en: After PSG, I captained Bolton in a League Cup final. Their fans said I was so good they named me twice.
clue3_ar: بعد باريس سان جيرمان، قدت بولتون قائداً في نهائي كأس الرابطة. وكان جمهوره يقول إنني بارع لدرجة أنهم سمّوني مرتين.
notes: sources: went with friend Binebi Numa to Borussia Neunkirchen training, asked to join in — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jay-Jay_Okocha + old set; 1993 solo goal v Karlsruhe beating Oliver Kahn, Goal of the Year — Wikipedia ; https://nannews.ng/okocha-credits-germany-for-shaping-his-football-career/ ; Olympic gold 1996 — old set; Bolton captain in 2004 League Cup final (lost to Middlesbrough), 'so good they named him twice' — Wikipedia ; https://www.planetfootball.com/nostalgia/tribute-amazing-jay-jay-okocha-great-bolton-team ; https://supersport.com/africaxi/news/6e0cfd84-ea95-4020-ae1a-5285904d60c0/jay-jay-okocha---so-good-they-named-him-twice . Turkish citizenship/name at Fenerbahçe left out (Wikipedia only).

name: Alessandro Costacurta
clue1_en: I spent one season on loan in the third tier at Monza before coming home for good.
clue1_ar: قضيت موسماً معاراً في الدرجة الثالثة مع مونزا قبل أن أعود نهائياً إلى ناديي.
clue2_en: In 1994, suspensions kept me out of both the Champions League final and the World Cup final.
clue2_ar: عام 1994 حرمني الإيقاف من المشاركة في نهائي دوري الأبطال ونهائي كأس العالم معاً.
clue3_en: I won five European Cups with AC Milan. At 41, I scored a penalty and became Serie A's oldest ever scorer at the time.
clue3_ar: فزت بكأس أوروبا خمس مرات مع ميلان. وفي الحادية والأربعين سجّلت من ركلة جزاء وصرت آنذاك أكبر هداف سناً في تاريخ الدوري الإيطالي.
notes: sources: suspended for 1994 CL final (sent off v Monaco in semi) and 1994 WC final (booked v Bulgaria) — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alessandro_Costacurta ; https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/news/0191-0e6a62609e22-0c25b66ba6e5-1000--milan-prepare-for-final-session ; https://thefootballfaithful.com/four-players-who-were-suspended-for-the-world-cup-final/ ; penalty v Udinese 19 May 2007 at 41 years 25 days, oldest Serie A scorer until Ibrahimović 2023 — Wikipedia + old set; five European Cups — old set. Old clue said 'in my last game': not confirmed, dropped. Clue 1 unchanged.

name: Claudio Caniggia
clue1_en: I ran the 100 metres before football and moved from Buenos Aires to Verona at 21.
clue1_ar: مارست سباق 100 متر قبل كرة القدم، وانتقلت من بوينس آيرس إلى فيرونا في الحادية والعشرين.
clue2_en: I scored the goal that knocked Brazil out of the 1990 World Cup, then missed the final through suspension.
clue2_ar: سجّلت الهدف الذي أقصى البرازيل من كأس العالم 1990، ثم غبت عن النهائي بسبب الإيقاف.
clue3_en: I had long blond hair and played for Atalanta and Roma. At the 2002 World Cup, I became the first player ever sent off from the bench.
clue3_ar: كان شعري أشقر طويلاً، ولعبت لأتالانتا وروما. وفي كأس العالم 2002 صرت أول لاعب يُطرد وهو جالس على دكة البدلاء.
notes: sources: red card from the bench for dissent v Sweden, 2002 WC, first in WC history — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claudio_Caniggia ; https://edition.cnn.com/2002/WORLD/worldcup/06/12/argswe.report/index.html ; https://www.dawn.com/news/42849 ; https://fourfourtwo.com/features/players-sent-off-at-a-world-cup ; 100 m athletics — Wikipedia + old set; Atalanta, Roma — facts.jsonl. Clues 1 and 2 unchanged.

name: Tony Adams
clue1_en: I made my debut at 17 and became captain at 21. In 1990, I was jailed for drink-driving and served half of a four-month sentence.
clue1_ar: خضت أول مباراة لي في السابعة عشرة وصرت قائداً في الحادية والعشرين. وفي 1990 سُجنت بسبب القيادة تحت تأثير الكحول، وقضيت نصف حكم بأربعة أشهر.
clue2_en: I sealed the 1998 title with a left-foot volley. In 2000, I founded a clinic to help athletes with addictions.
clue2_ar: حسمت لقب 1998 بتسديدة طائرة بقدمي اليسرى. وفي 2000 أسّست عيادة لمساعدة الرياضيين على التعافي من الإدمان.
clue3_en: I spent my whole career at Arsenal, captained them for 14 years and won two league and cup doubles.
clue3_ar: قضيت مسيرتي كلها في أرسنال، وكنت قائده 14 عاماً، وفزت معه بثنائية الدوري والكأس مرتين.
notes: sources: debut 5 Nov 1983 aged 17, captain 1 Jan 1988 aged 21, 14 years — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tony_Adams_(footballer) + old set; four-month sentence for drink-driving 1990, freed after half — Wikipedia ; https://www.goal.com/en/news/i-was-pssing-shtting-myself-adams-says-helping-fellow/5vpoggzwa2f6124ieuzt7c1ab ; https://bigissue.com/latest/tony-adams-latest-to-share-his-emotional-story-on-more-than-my-past-podcast ; founded Sporting Chance Clinic Sept 2000 — Wikipedia + Big Issue; doubles 1997–98 and 2001–02 — Wikipedia; 1998 volley — old set.

name: Hugo Sanchez
clue1_en: My sister was a gymnast at the 1976 Olympics. I studied dentistry while playing, and spent off-seasons on loan in San Diego.
clue1_ar: كانت أختي لاعبة جمباز في أولمبياد 1976. ودرست طب الأسنان وأنا ألعب، وقضيت فترات التوقف معاراً إلى سان دييغو.
clue2_en: At the 1986 World Cup, I missed a penalty in a 1–1 draw with Paraguay. In 1989–90, I scored 38 league goals, all with one touch.
clue2_ar: في كأس العالم 1986، أهدرت ركلة جزاء في التعادل 1–1 مع باراغواي. وفي موسم 1989–90، سجّلت 38 هدفاً في الدوري، كلها بلمسة واحدة.
clue3_en: I left Atlético for their city rivals Real Madrid in 1985. I celebrated my goals there with a somersault.
clue3_ar: تركت أتلتيكو إلى جاره اللدود ريال مدريد عام 1985، وكنت أحتفل بأهدافي هناك بشقلبة في الهواء.
notes: sources: sister an Olympic gymnast at Montreal 1976 — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hugo_S%C3%A1nchez ; https://inside.fifa.com/en/news/when-somersaulting-sanchez-shouldered-mexico-s-hopes-2847639 ; dental surgery degree from UNAM while at Pumas — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hugo_S%C3%A1nchez ; https://www.pressreader.com/australia/fourfourtwo/20170701/283077004237495 ; loaned by Pumas to San Diego Sockers for 1979 and 1980 off-seasons — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hugo_S%C3%A1nchez (Sockers in facts.jsonl) ; missed penalty in 1–1 draw with Paraguay, 1986 — https://inside.fifa.com/en/news/when-somersaulting-sanchez-shouldered-mexico-s-hopes-2847639 ; 38 one-touch goals in 1989–90 — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hugo_S%C3%A1nchez (old set) ; somersault celebrations — https://inside.fifa.com/en/news/when-somersaulting-sanchez-shouldered-mexico-s-hopes-2847639 ; Atlético to Real Madrid 1985 — facts.jsonl. Left out: whether the somersault honoured his sister (Wikipedia) or his own gymnastics (FIFA).

name: Demetrio Albertini
clue1_en: I was 11 when my country won the 1982 World Cup, and I dreamed of having my own Panini sticker. At 17, I made my league debut for my boyhood club.
clue1_ar: كنت في الحادية عشرة حين فاز منتخب بلادي بكأس العالم 1982، وحلمت بأن تكون لي صورة في ألبوم بانيني. وفي السابعة عشرة، لعبت أول مباراة في الدوري مع نادي طفولتي.
clue2_en: In the 1994 World Cup final shootout, I scored my first penalty as a professional. Four years later, I missed one against France.
clue2_ar: في ركلات ترجيح نهائي كأس العالم 1994، سجّلت أول ركلة جزاء في مسيرتي الاحترافية. وبعد أربع سنوات، أهدرت ركلتي أمام فرنسا.
clue3_en: After years at AC Milan, I scored a free kick at the Bernabéu for Atlético. Rijkaard then brought me to Barcelona, and we won the league.
clue3_ar: بعد سنوات في ميلان، سجّلت ركلة حرة في البرنابيو مع أتلتيكو. ثم ضمّني ريكارد إلى برشلونة، وفزنا بالدوري.
notes: sources: aged 11 at the 1982 World Cup, dreamed of his own Panini sticker; debut for boyhood club Milan in 1988/89 — https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/1647659/in-my-own-words-demetrio-albertini (first person) ; debut 15 Jan 1989 aged 17 — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demetrio_Albertini ; scored in the 1994 World Cup final shootout, his first penalty as a pro — https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/1647659/in-my-own-words-demetrio-albertini ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demetrio_Albertini ; missed in the 1998 shootout vs France — old set, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demetrio_Albertini ; free kick at the Bernabéu in the Madrid derby with Atlético 2002/03; Rijkaard persuaded him to join Barça, league title 2005 — https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/news/1647659/in-my-own-words-demetrio-albertini ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Demetrio_Albertini (league title)

name: Robert Prosinecki
clue1_en: I was born in Germany. A coach in Zagreb said he would eat his diploma if I made it, so I left for Belgrade.
clue1_ar: وُلدت في ألمانيا. قال مدرب في زغرب إنه سيأكل شهادته إن نجحت، فرحلت إلى بلغراد.
clue2_en: I won the European Cup with Red Star in 1991. In 1998, that same Zagreb coach took me to the World Cup, and I scored in the third-place match.
clue2_ar: فزت بكأس أوروبا للأندية مع النجم الأحمر عام 1991. وعام 1998، اصطحبني المدرب نفسه إلى كأس العالم، وسجّلت في مباراة المركز الثالث.
clue3_en: I played for both Real Madrid and Barcelona, and scored at World Cups for two different countries.
clue3_ar: لعبت لريال مدريد وبرشلونة، وسجّلت في كأس العالم لمنتخبين مختلفين.
notes: sources: born in Schwenningen, West Germany — facts.jsonl ; Blažević at Dinamo sent him away and said he would eat his coaching diploma if he became a proper player; he moved to Red Star (1987, facts.jsonl) — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Prosine%C4%8Dki ; https://thatsliquidfootball.com/2018/09/06/love-letters-to-the-european-union-fiery-madness/ ; Blažević later coached Croatia at the 1998 World Cup with him; goal vs Netherlands in the third-place match — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Prosine%C4%8Dki ; 1991 European Cup with Red Star, goals at World Cups for Yugoslavia (1990, UAE) and Croatia (1998) — old set, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Prosine%C4%8Dki ; Real Madrid and Barcelona — facts.jsonl

name: Emilio Butragueno
clue1_en: On my league debut in 1984, I came on at half-time with us 2–0 down at Cádiz. I scored twice and we won 3–2.
clue1_ar: في أول مباراة لي في الدوري عام 1984، دخلت بين الشوطين ونحن متأخرون 2–0 في قادش. سجّلت هدفين وفزنا 3–2.
clue2_en: At the 1986 World Cup, I scored four goals in a 5–1 win over Denmark.
clue2_ar: في كأس العالم 1986، سجّلت أربعة أهداف في الفوز 5–1 على الدنمارك.
clue3_en: Real Madrid's famous 1980s academy generation was named after my nickname. We won five league titles in a row.
clue3_ar: حمل جيل أكاديمية ريال مدريد الشهير في الثمانينيات اسم لقبي، وفزنا بالدوري خمس مرات متتالية.
notes: sources: debut 5 Feb 1984 at Cádiz, on at half-time at 2–0 down, two goals, 3–2 win — https://thesefootballtimes.co/2017/11/28/emilio-butragueno-real-madrids-vulture/ ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emilio_Butrague%C3%B1o ; https://www.citizen.co.za/sport/soccer/world-soccer/five-of-the-most-memorable-debuts-in-laliga-history/ ; four goals vs Denmark in a 5–1 win, 1986 — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emilio_Butrague%C3%B1o ; https://thesefootballtimes.co/2017/11/28/emilio-butragueno-real-madrids-vulture/ ; Quinta del Buitre named after his nickname — https://thesefootballtimes.co/2017/11/28/emilio-butragueno-real-madrids-vulture/ ; https://www.realmadrid.com/en-US/the-club/history/football-legends/emilio-butragueno-santos ; five league titles in a row — old set. Left out: rejected at first Real Madrid trial (one source only).

name: Ivan Zamorano
clue1_en: I played in Switzerland for St. Gallen before moving to Seville.
clue1_ar: لعبت في سويسرا لسانت غالن قبل انتقالي إلى إشبيلية.
clue2_en: At Inter, I wore 1+8 on my shirt after giving up my number to a new star.
clue2_ar: في إنتر، ارتديت 1+8 على قميصي بعد أن تخليت عن رقمي لنجم جديد.
clue3_en: After Real Madrid and Inter, I ended my career at Colo-Colo for free. My late father had dreamed of seeing me in their shirt.
clue3_ar: بعد ريال مدريد وإنتر، أنهيت مسيرتي مع كولو كولو دون مقابل، فقد كان والدي الراحل يحلم برؤيتي بقميصه.
notes: sources: clue 1 and 2 unchanged from the old set ; ended career at Colo-Colo (2003, facts.jsonl), played for free while the club was in bankruptcy, to fulfil his late father's dream of seeing him in the Colo-Colo shirt — https://redgol.cl/colocolo/reviven-el-gesto-de-ivan-zamorano-con-colo-colo-jugue-gratis-el-club-estaba-en-quiebra-20240118-RDG-265689.html ; https://www.eldinamo.cl/deportes/2020/10/23/ivan-zamorano-esos-seis-meses-que-estuve-en-colo-colo-senti-a-mi-papa-muy-cerca/ (his own words in both) ; Real Madrid and Inter — facts.jsonl. Left out: father's death from appendicitis when he was 13 (Wikipedia only).

name: Andreas Moller
clue1_en: In 1995, I went down without being touched against Karlsruhe and won a penalty. I became the first player my federation banned for a dive.
clue1_ar: عام 1995، سقطت دون أن يلمسني أحد أمام كارلسروه وحصلت على ركلة جزاء، فصرت أول لاعب يوقفه اتحاد بلادي بسبب التمثيل.
clue2_en: I scored the winning kick in the Euro 96 semi-final shootout at Wembley and copied Gascoigne's pose. I was already banned for the final.
clue2_ar: سجّلت الركلة الحاسمة في ركلات ترجيح نصف نهائي يورو 96 في ويمبلي، وقلّدت وقفة غاسكوين. وكنت موقوفاً مسبقاً عن النهائي.
clue3_en: I won the Champions League with Dortmund in 1997, then crossed to their fiercest rivals, Schalke.
clue3_ar: فزت بدوري الأبطال مع دورتموند عام 1997، ثم انتقلت إلى غريمه الأشرس شالكه.
notes: sources: April 1995 dive vs Karlsruher SC, two-game ban and DM 10,000 fine, first DFB ban for a dive — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andreas_M%C3%B6ller ; https://www.sport1.de/fussball/bundesliga/2016/12/keine-sperre-schwalbe-von-timo-werner-anders-als-der-fall-andreas-moeller ; https://web.de/magazine/sport/thema/andreas-moeller ; Euro 96 semi-final winning shootout penalty vs England at Wembley, Gascoigne-style pose, suspended for the final — https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/news/0253-0d7bd19d9445-0d79795f8ddb-1000--germany-condemn-england-to-sudden-death-again/ ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andreas_M%C3%B6ller ; 1997 Champions League with Dortmund, Schalke 2000 — old set, facts.jsonl

name: Claudio Taffarel
clue1_en: I played beach volleyball as a boy and became the first foreign goalkeeper in Serie A.
clue1_ar: لعبت الكرة الطائرة الشاطئية وأنا صغير، وأصبحت أول حارس مرمى أجنبي في الدوري الإيطالي.
clue2_en: I saved a penalty in the 1994 World Cup final shootout. Weeks later, I played up front for a parish team in Reggio.
clue2_ar: تصديت لركلة في ركلات ترجيح نهائي كأس العالم 1994. وبعد أسابيع، لعبت مهاجماً مع فريق كنيسة في ريجيو.
clue3_en: I won the World Cup and the UEFA Cup with Galatasaray. In 2003, my car broke down on the way to a new club, and I took it as a sign to retire.
clue3_ar: فزت بكأس العالم وبكأس الاتحاد الأوروبي مع غلطة سراي. وعام 2003، تعطلت سيارتي في طريقي إلى نادٍ جديد، فاعتبرتها إشارة للاعتزال.
notes: sources: clue 1 unchanged from old set ; saved Massaro's penalty in the 1994 final shootout — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cl%C3%A1udio_Taffarel ; https://www.goal.com/it/notizie/taffarel-il-portiere-della-reggiana-che-vinse-i-mondiali-di/idtieaowfl5u1f8ej2hcoe1f5 ; weeks after the World Cup played a few games as a forward for the Reggio parish team Preziosissimo Sangue — https://www.goal.com/it/notizie/taffarel-il-portiere-della-reggiana-che-vinse-i-mondiali-di/idtieaowfl5u1f8ej2hcoe1f5 ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cl%C3%A1udio_Taffarel ; 2003 car broke down on the way to join Empoli, saw it as a sign and retired — same two sources ; UEFA Cup with Galatasaray — old set

name: Zvonimir Boban
clue1_en: I captained my Zagreb club at 19. In 1990, I kicked a policeman during a riot at a match against Red Star and was banned.
clue1_ar: كنت قائد ناديي في زغرب في التاسعة عشرة. وعام 1990، ركلت شرطياً خلال أعمال شغب في مباراة أمام النجم الأحمر، فأُوقفت.
clue2_en: I won the Champions League with AC Milan in 1994. Four years later, I captained my country to third place at the World Cup.
clue2_ar: فزت بدوري الأبطال مع ميلان عام 1994. وبعد أربع سنوات، قدت منتخب بلادي قائداً إلى المركز الثالث في كأس العالم.
clue3_en: I spent a decade at AC Milan. Later, I took a history degree in Zagreb.
clue3_ar: قضيت عقداً في ميلان. ولاحقاً، حصلت على شهادة في التاريخ في زغرب.
notes: sources: Dinamo captain at 19 — old set, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zvonimir_Boban ; kicked a policeman in the 13 May 1990 riot at the Dinamo–Red Star match, then banned (six months per La Nación) — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zvonimir_Boban ; https://www.lanacion.com.ar/deportes/zvonimir-boban-romantico-nacionalista-golpe-incendio-balcanes-nid2364604 ; 1994 Champions League with Milan — old set ; captained Croatia to third at France 1998 — https://www.lanacion.com.ar/deportes/zvonimir-boban-romantico-nacionalista-golpe-incendio-balcanes-nid2364604 ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zvonimir_Boban (third place) ; history degree from the University of Zagreb, thesis on Christianity in the Roman Empire — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zvonimir_Boban ; https://www.lanacion.com.ar/deportes/zvonimir-boban-romantico-nacionalista-golpe-incendio-balcanes-nid2364604 ; https://forzaitalianfootball.com/2015/07/legend-of-calcio-zvonimir-boban/ | lead fix: clue 3 rewritten (religion topic removed).

name: Roberto Donadoni
clue1_en: I started at Atalanta. In a 1988 European Cup match in Belgrade, a collision knocked me out, and my coach later wrote that I looked dead.
clue1_ar: بدأت مع أتالانتا. وفي مباراة بكأس أوروبا للأندية في بلغراد عام 1988، أفقدني اصطدام الوعي، وكتب مدربي لاحقاً أنني بدوت كالميت.
clue2_en: I won three European Cups with Milan, and missed in the 1990 World Cup semi-final shootout.
clue2_ar: فزت بكأس أوروبا للأندية ثلاث مرات مع ميلان، وأهدرت ركلتي في ركلات ترجيح نصف نهائي كأس العالم 1990.
clue3_en: After AC Milan, I played in New York. I later coached Italy at Euro 2008, where we lost to Spain on penalties and I was let go.
clue3_ar: بعد ميلان، لعبت في نيويورك. ثم درّبت منتخب إيطاليا في يورو 2008، وخسرنا أمام إسبانيا بركلات الترجيح فأُقلت.
notes: sources: Atalanta — facts.jsonl ; knocked unconscious with a broken jaw after a collision with Vasilijević, Red Star v Milan, European Cup, Belgrade, Nov 1988 — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roberto_Donadoni ; https://www.index.hr/sport/clanak/susret-milanovih-besmrtnika-sa-smrcu-u-beogradu-pljuvali-su-nas-i-huskali-pse/2322601.aspx (Sacchi's memoir, quoted there: he looked as though he was dead) ; broken jaw left out (Wikipedia only) ; clue 2 unchanged from old set ; New York MetroStars 1996 — facts.jsonl ; Italy coach at Euro 2008, lost QF to Spain on penalties, dismissed 26 June 2008 — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roberto_Donadoni ; https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/news/0254-0d7bf6331c93-fc0995a465ef-1000--lippi-returns-as-italy-depose-donadoni/ ; https://www.filgoal.com/articles/159337/donadoni-leaves-italy-lippi-replaces-him

name: Enzo Francescoli
clue1_en: I started at a small Montevideo club and was named South American Footballer of the Year in 1984.
clue1_ar: بدأت في نادٍ صغير بمونتيفيديو، واختُرت أفضل لاعب في أمريكا الجنوبية عام 1984.
clue2_en: I reached the Copa América final four times and won three. I was named best player of the 1983 and 1995 tournaments.
clue2_ar: بلغت نهائي كوبا أمريكا أربع مرات وفزت بثلاثة منها، واختُرت أفضل لاعب في بطولتي 1983 و1995.
clue3_en: I won the Copa Libertadores with River Plate. In France, a young Zidane admired me so much that he named his son after me.
clue3_ar: فزت بكأس ليبرتادوريس مع ريفر بليت. وفي فرنسا، أُعجب بي زيدان الشاب إلى حد أنه سمّى ابنه تيمناً بي.
notes: sources: clue 1 unchanged from old set ; four Copa América tournaments, four finals, three titles; best player in 1983 and 1995 — https://442.perfil.com/noticias/futbol/schiaffino-y-francescoli-principes-del-imperio-charrua.phtml ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Enzo_Francescoli ; Copa Libertadores with River Plate (1996) — same two sources ; Zidane met him in France, admired him and named his son Enzo after him — same two sources (old set). Left out: the origin of the nickname (Ciocca per Wikipedia, Víctor Hugo Morales per Perfil) and the Peñarol trial (reason differs by source).

name: Dejan Savicevic
clue1_en: Against Milan in Belgrade, I put my club ahead, but fog stopped the match and wiped out my goal. In the replay the next day, I missed in the shootout.
clue1_ar: أمام ميلان في بلغراد، منحت فريقي التقدم، لكن الضباب أوقف المباراة وألغى هدفي. وفي الإعادة في اليوم التالي، أهدرت ركلتي في ركلات الترجيح.
clue2_en: In the 1994 Champions League final against Barcelona, I scored from long range to make it 3–0.
clue2_ar: في نهائي دوري الأبطال 1994 أمام برشلونة، سجّلت من مسافة بعيدة لنتقدم 3–0.
clue3_en: I spent six years at AC Milan, often at odds with Capello. Later, I became president of Montenegro's football federation.
clue3_ar: قضيت ست سنوات في ميلان، وكثيراً ما اختلفت مع كابيلو. ولاحقاً، صرت رئيساً لاتحاد الجبل الأسود لكرة القدم.
notes: sources: Red Star v Milan, European Cup second round (Nov 1988 per RSSSF), he scored, fog made the referee abandon it, replay next day 1–1, Milan won 4–2 on penalties, he missed — https://www.the42.ie/red-star-belgrade-4214348-Sep2018/ ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dejan_Savi%C4%87evi%C4%87 ; https://rsssf.org/ec/ec198889det.html ; 1994 final goal for 3–0 from long range — https://lastwordonsports.com/2016/01/05/forgotten-idols-dejan-savicevic/ ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dejan_Savi%C4%87evi%C4%87 ; difficult relationship with Capello — same two ; president of the Football Association of Montenegro — same two ; six years at Milan (1992–98) — facts.jsonl. Left out: who coined 'Il Genio' (Berlusconi vs a Gazzetta journalist), lob vs half-volley, the 35/25-yard distance, the year of the fog match (the42 says 1989).

name: Brian Laudrup
clue1_en: I was born in Vienna while my father was playing there. In 1990, my brother and I quit the national team after a row with the coach.
clue1_ar: وُلدت في فيينا حين كان والدي يلعب هناك. وعام 1990، اعتزلت مع أخي اللعب الدولي بعد خلاف مع المدرب.
clue2_en: I came back when we got a late call-up to Euro 92, and we won it. Later, I was twice voted player of the year in Scotland.
clue2_ar: عدت حين استُدعينا متأخرين إلى يورو 92، وفزنا باللقب. ولاحقاً، اختُرت مرتين أفضل لاعب في اسكتلندا.
clue3_en: I played for Bayern, AC Milan and Rangers. My older brother was a star too.
clue3_ar: لعبت لبايرن ميونخ وميلان ورينجرز، وكان أخي الأكبر نجماً أيضاً.
notes: sources: born in Vienna while father Finn played for Wiener Sport-Club — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brian_Laudrup (old set) ; he and Michael quit the national team in November 1990 over coach Richard Møller Nielsen; only Brian returned for Euro 92, where Denmark replaced Yugoslavia at short notice and won — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brian_Laudrup ; https://extratime.com/articles/21771/denmark-football-history---part-3---euro-92-failure-to-finest-hour ; https://mp.scotsman.com/sport/football/johnny-phillips-great-danes-made-the-most-of-their-late-call-up-5913545 ; twice player of the year in Scotland — old set ; clue 3 unchanged from old set. Left out: his 2010 lymphoma (health, kept out by choice).

name: Jaap Stam
clue1_en: I played for my hometown amateur club, and only made my professional debut at 20, in the Dutch second tier.
clue1_ar: لعبت لنادي الهواة في مدينتي، ولم أخض أول مباراة احترافية إلا في العشرين، في الدرجة الثانية الهولندية.
clue2_en: I wasn't even on the list for the Euro 2000 semi-final shootout against Italy, but I stepped up and missed.
clue2_ar: لم يكن اسمي حتى على قائمة المسددين في ركلات ترجيح نصف نهائي يورو 2000 أمام إيطاليا، لكنني تقدمت وأهدرت ركلتي.
clue3_en: I won the treble with Manchester United in 1999. Ferguson sold me to Lazio soon after my book came out, and later called it a mistake.
clue3_ar: فزت بالثلاثية مع مانشستر يونايتد عام 1999. وباعني فيرغسون إلى لاتسيو بعد صدور كتابي بقليل، ثم وصف ذلك لاحقاً بالخطأ.
notes: sources: hometown club DOS Kampen (Kampen, facts.jsonl); pro debut for FC Zwolle on 15 Aug 1992 in the Eerste Divisie, aged 20 (born 17 Jul 1972) — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jaap_Stam ; not on the penalty list before the Euro 2000 semi-final, missed in the shootout v Italy — https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/12017311/jaap-stam-i-wasnt-suppose-to-take-penalty-at-euro-2000 (his own words) ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jaap_Stam ; 1999 treble — old set ; sold to Lazio in 2001 soon after his autobiography; Ferguson later called it a mistake — https://fourfourtwo.com/news/sir-alex-admits-stam-mistake ; https://thesefootballtimes.co/2018/02/22/the-story-of-jaap-stam-and-sir-alex-fergusons-greatest-mistake/ ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jaap_Stam . The clue does not say the book caused the sale (Stam disputes that).

name: Stefan Effenberg
clue1_en: I played in Florence twice in the 1990s, between spells in Mönchengladbach.
clue1_ar: لعبت في فلورنسا مرتين في التسعينيات، بين فترتين في مونشنغلادباخ.
clue2_en: I was thrown out of my country's squad at the 1994 World Cup for a rude gesture at our own fans.
clue2_ar: استُبعدت من تشكيلة منتخب بلادي في كأس العالم 1994 بسبب إشارة بذيئة نحو جماهيرنا.
clue3_en: I captained Bayern Munich to the 2001 Champions League. I scored our equaliser from the spot in the final and was named the competition's best player.
clue3_ar: قدت بايرن ميونخ قائداً إلى لقب دوري الأبطال 2001، وسجّلت هدف التعادل من ركلة جزاء في النهائي، واختُرت أفضل لاعب في البطولة.
notes: sources: clues 1 and 2 unchanged from old set ; captain in the 2001 final, equalising penalty v Valencia (1–1), named most valuable player of the 2000–01 Champions League — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stefan_Effenberg ; https://fcbayern.com/en/news/2023/04/unmatched-stefan-effenberg ; https://fcbayern.com/en/news/2020/05/bayerns-ucl-win-2001 ; https://mg.co.za/?p=296964 (Kahn was man of the match, not Effenberg). Left out: Strunz affair, 2001 assault conviction, 2002 Playboy remarks (sensitive).

name: Aldair
clue1_en: In my only season in Lisbon, we lost the European Cup final to Milan. Then I moved to Rome in 1990.
clue1_ar: في موسمي الوحيد في لشبونة، خسرنا نهائي كأس أوروبا للأندية أمام ميلان. ثم انتقلت إلى روما عام 1990.
clue2_en: I won the 1994 World Cup and the Serie A title in 2001.
clue2_ar: فزت بكأس العالم 1994 وبلقب الدوري الإيطالي عام 2001.
clue3_en: Roma retired my shirt when I left after thirteen years. In my forties, I was still playing, for a club in San Marino.
clue3_ar: حجب روما قميصي بعد 13 عاماً قضيتها هناك. وفي الأربعينيات من عمري، كنت ما زلت ألعب لنادٍ في سان مارينو.
notes: sources: Benfica 1989, Roma 1990 — facts.jsonl ; Benfica reached the 1990 European Cup final, lost to Milan — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aldair ; https://www.goal.com/it/notizie/pluto-aldair-una-carriera-da-big-passata-lontano-dai-riflettori/iyer6u4xsxid1tjmy71ug5035 ; Roma fans' nickname Pluto, from the Disney dog — same two (Goal gives the origin) ; 1994 World Cup, 2001 Serie A — old set ; Roma retired his number 6 when he left in 2003 (later given to Strootman with his approval) — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aldair ; https://www.football-italia.net/36617/strootman-roma-choice-was-easy ; Goal ; joined SS Murata, San Marino, in 2007 aged 41 — Goal ; Wikipedia (2007), born 1965 (facts.jsonl). | lead fix: clue 2 reverted to the old text (nickname hint).

name: Ian Wright
clue1_en: A primary school teacher helped me learn to read and write. I left school, worked as a plasterer, and only turned pro at 21.
clue1_ar: ساعدني معلم في المرحلة الابتدائية على تعلّم القراءة والكتابة. تركت المدرسة وعملت في تلييس الجدران، ولم أحترف إلا في الحادية والعشرين.
clue2_en: In 1997, I broke a club scoring record that had stood since the 1930s.
clue2_ar: عام 1997، حطّمت رقماً قياسياً لأهداف ناديي صمد منذ الثلاثينيات.
clue3_en: I starred for Crystal Palace and Arsenal. Both of my sons went on to play in the Premier League.
clue3_ar: تألقت مع كريستال بالاس وأرسنال، ولعب ابناي كلاهما لاحقاً في الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز.
notes: sources: primary teacher Sydney Pigden helped him with reading and writing — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ian_Wright ; https://www.tes.com/news/ian-wright-his-best-teacher-mr-pigden ; https://www.londonmuseum.org.uk/collections/london-stories/ian-wright-arsenal-hero-london-legend/ ; left school, plasterer, first pro contract 1985 aged 21 — London Museum page ; Wikipedia (Aug 1985, before his 22nd birthday) ; clue 2 unchanged from old set (Bastin's record, 13 Sep 1997) ; sons Shaun and Bradley Wright-Phillips both played in the Premier League — London Museum page ; Wikipedia. Left out: 32 days in Chelmsford prison (sensitive), the 1990 FA Cup final goals (one source found).

name: Fernando Redondo
clue1_en: I started at Argentinos Juniors, and turned down the 1998 World Cup after the coach told me to cut my long hair.
clue1_ar: بدأت مع أرخنتينوس جونيورز، ورفضت المشاركة في كأس العالم 1998 بعدما طلب مني المدرب قص شعري الطويل.
clue2_en: My back-heel assist at Old Trafford in 2000 is one of the Champions League's most famous moments.
clue2_ar: تمريرتي بالكعب في أولد ترافورد عام 2000 من أشهر لحظات دوري الأبطال.
clue3_en: I won two Champions Leagues with Real Madrid. At AC Milan, I hurt my knee before my first game and asked them to stop paying me until I was fit.
clue3_ar: فزت بدوري الأبطال مرتين مع ريال مدريد. وفي ميلان، أُصبت في ركبتي قبل أول مباراة، وطلبت من النادي إيقاف راتبي حتى أتعافى.
notes: sources: clues 1 and 2 unchanged from old set ; two Champions Leagues with Real Madrid (1998, 2000) — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fernando_Redondo ; knee injury in pre-season after joining Milan in 2000, before playing a match; in 2001 asked Milan to stop paying his wages until he could play — https://uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/news/017d-0e6a8526557a-4dd491ecb0c6-1000--injured-redondo-forsakes-salary ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fernando_Redondo ; https://www.football-italia.net/136658/redondo-milan-injury-nightmare . Left out: law studies (Wikipedia only), salary figure (sources differ).

name: Robbie Fowler
clue1_en: I grew up supporting our city rivals and scored five goals in a League Cup tie at 18.
clue1_ar: نشأت مشجعاً لغريم ناديي في المدينة، وسجّلت خمسة أهداف في مباراة بكأس الرابطة وأنا في الثامنة عشرة.
clue2_en: At Arsenal in 1997, I told the referee their keeper hadn't fouled me. He gave the penalty anyway, and my kick was saved.
clue2_ar: أمام أرسنال عام 1997، قلت للحكم إن الحارس لم يعرقلني، لكنه احتسب ركلة الجزاء رغم ذلك، وتصدى الحارس لتسديدتي.
clue3_en: I had two spells at Liverpool. In 1994, I scored a Premier League hat-trick against Arsenal in four minutes and 33 seconds.
clue3_ar: لعبت لليفربول على فترتين. وعام 1994، سجّلت ثلاثية في الدوري الإنجليزي أمام أرسنال خلال أربع دقائق و33 ثانية.
notes: sources: clue 1 unchanged from old set ; March 1997 at Highbury, told referee Gerald Ashby that Seaman had not fouled him, penalty stood, Seaman saved, McAteer scored the rebound; UEFA fair-play award — https://www.liverpoolfc.com/news/first-team/212975-march-24-in-lfc-history-smicer-s-strike-fowler-honesty-and-more ; https://www.lfchistory.net/articles/1232 ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robbie_Fowler ; 1994 hat-trick v Arsenal in 4 min 33 s — old set, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robbie_Fowler ; two Liverpool spells — facts.jsonl. Left out: the dockers T-shirt fine (Reuters reposts only).

name: Paolo Di Canio
clue1_en: As a boy, I was overweight and wore orthopaedic shoes. I grew up in a Roma neighbourhood but supported the other club in the city.
clue1_ar: كنت في صغري بديناً وأرتدي أحذية طبية. ونشأت في حيّ يشجع روما، لكنني شجعت النادي الآخر في المدينة.
clue2_en: In 1998, I pushed a referee to the ground. Two years later, I caught a cross instead of shooting into an empty net, because the keeper was hurt.
clue2_ar: عام 1998، دفعت حكماً فأسقطته أرضاً. وبعد عامين، أمسكت كرة عرضية بيدي بدلاً من التسديد في مرمى خالٍ، لأن الحارس كان مصاباً.
clue3_en: I starred for West Ham and scored a famous volley against Wimbledon. FIFA gave me its fair play award in 2001.
clue3_ar: تألقت مع وست هام، وسجّلت هدفاً شهيراً بتسديدة طائرة أمام ويمبلدون. ومنحني الفيفا جائزة اللعب النظيف عام 2001.
notes: sources: overweight, knock-kneed, orthopaedic shoes as a boy; grew up in Quarticciolo, a mostly Roma-supporting area, drawn to Lazio — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paolo_Di_Canio ; https://www.flashscore.com/news/soccer-premier-league-flashback-fire-controversy-and-a-touch-of-genius-the-life-of-paolo-di-canio/ClspruNO ; pushed referee Paul Alcock, Sept 1998 — old set, same two sources ; Dec 2000 at Everton caught the ball instead of shooting into an empty net while keeper Paul Gerrard was injured; FIFA Fair Play Award 2001 — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_Gerrard ; https://fourfourtwo.com/news/great-acts-sporting-fair-play ; https://www.uefa.com/insideuefa/news/025e-0f9059a36425-5609484c6f69-1000--di-canio-wins-fair-play-award ; Wimbledon volley March 2000 — old set, Flashscore. Left out: fascist tattoos and salutes (sensitive).

name: Predrag Mijatovic
clue1_en: I came from Titograd and won the U-20 World Cup with Yugoslavia in 1987.
clue1_ar: جئت من تيتوغراد، وفزت بكأس العالم للشباب مع يوغوسلافيا عام 1987.
clue2_en: In 1998, I scored the winner in the Champions League final against Juventus. Weeks later, my World Cup penalty against the Netherlands hit the bar.
clue2_ar: عام 1998، سجّلت هدف الفوز في نهائي دوري الأبطال أمام يوفنتوس. وبعد أسابيع، ارتطمت ركلة جزائي أمام هولندا في كأس العالم بالعارضة.
clue3_en: Real Madrid signed me from Valencia in 1996, and I later moved to Fiorentina. I'm a striker from Montenegro.
clue3_ar: ضمّني ريال مدريد من فالنسيا عام 1996، ثم انتقلت لاحقاً إلى فيورنتينا. أنا مهاجم من الجبل الأسود.
